page.overview:
Who is Zeff?

Zeff is the head chef and owner of the Baratie, as well as the adoptive father and mentor of Sanji.

Once the feared "Red-Leg" Zeff, captain of the Cook Pirates, his notoriety ended in a storm that annihilated both his crew and ship. After saving a young Sanji from this storm and co-surviving months of starvation as castaways, he launched the Baratie, raising Sanji as his trainee.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Baratie Arc.

Zeff is a hardened, well-muscled man with light blonde hair; his highly distinct mustache extends two long "cords" some ways past his face, tied with blue ribbons at each end. As captain of the Cook Pirates, he wore relatively plain clothing with the standard cape-style captain's overcoat.
